chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Zubyan ibn Hakim al-Awdi, from Ali ibn al-Mughira, who said:

I said to Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him): 'I have a daughter of my brother who is an orphan, so sometimes something is gifted to her, so I eat from it. Then I feed her something after that from my wealth, so I say: O Lord, this for this!' So he (peace be upon him) said: 'There is no problem.'

key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no problem / it is permissible

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible for a guardian to eat an orphan's gift and feed the orphan from his own money?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Al-Kafi*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) validates a practical method of managing orphan's wealth where the guardian consumes a gift given to the orphan and subsequently feeds the orphan from his own funds, deeming the reciprocal exchange ('this for this') sufficient. This ruling highlights the flexibility in Shia jurisprudence regarding the *mal al-yatim* (orphan's property), prioritizing the guardian's ability to provide sustenance and care over strict material restitution, provided the value is equivalent. It underscores the principle that the guardian's consumption is not a penalty but a permissible transaction within the framework of stewardship.

en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, form Muhammad Bin Al Husayn, from Zubyan Bin hakeem Al Awdy, from Ali Bin Al Mugheira who said,

‘I said to Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, ‘With me is a  daughter of my brother who is an orphan, so sometimes something is gifted to her, so I eat from it. Then I feed her something after that from my wealth, so I am saying, ‘O Lord<sup>azwj</sup>! This is for this!’ So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘There is no problem’.
en.sarwar: 5. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn from Dhubyan ibn Hakim al-Awdiy from Ali ibn al-Mughirah who has said the following:

“I once said to abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, ‘I have an orphan girl of my brother. At certain times gifts are given to her and I eat a certain amount thereof. Thereafter I feed her a certain amount from my properties and I say, “O Lord, this is for what I have used.” He (the Imam), ‘Alayhi al-Salam, said, ‘It is not harmful.”’
